about: Search benchmark questions for saltmarsh-field-report.md. `expect` lists text that the right passage contains (each must occur once in the document); a passage counts as found if it overlaps any of them. Follow-ups carry the earlier turn they follow.

expect: under grant MRF-2291

expect: Each satellite message costs 0.18 euros

expect: The field supervisor, Tomasz Brekke

previous.question: When was the safety incident?
previous.answer: In March 2025, at the Low Rock station (S-11).

expect: a two-person rule applies to every visit

previous.question: Where did the data move to in March 2025?
previous.answer: From a server in the trust's office to object storage at a cloud provider.

previous.answer: Two of the new salinity sensors, by about 0.3 salinity units per quarter.

expect: calibrate them every month against standard seawater

previous.question: What did the board decide on 18 February 2026?
previous.answer: To make the network permanent, publish the data under CC BY 4.0, and add stations.

questions.question: How many more, and by when?
expect: four more stations will be added by the end of 2027
